confirmedFindingDisposition.reportedConfirmedMechanism: selectedId is unscoped React state. activeId prefers it over the current vehicle list and both detail/telemetry hooks are keyed only by that drive ID. There is no current-vehicle membership reconciliation or drive.vehicleId guard.

Local readiness uses isLoading, activeId and result.ok, not resolved/paused source state. TanStack initial paused queries can be pending with isLoading=false. A paused or disabled unresolved list enters noDrives; paused detail enters noEnergy; initial list loading does not make the summary/takeaway loading because detail is still disabled. A fatal detail gets an accurate QueryError in Energy but still the noEnergy text in Takeaway. retained includes refreshError only, so retained paused sources can be labeled Source available by the brief.

The no-guesswork blurb contradicts generic model constants and default/inferred pack assumptions. The warning about incomplete telemetry checks only absent/zero-length arrays. A nonempty payload with null elevation, isClimateOn and outsideTemp is accepted without this warning, although analyzeTelemetry substitutes climb=0, climateOn=true and ambient fallback. The brief correctly discloses model outputs, but this does not make all component/pack inputs observed.

other=max(0,observed-modeled0), so baseline.total=modeled0+max(0,observed-modeled0)=max(modeled0,observed). Whenever modeled0>observed the displayed Actual drive and was baseline exceed recorded energy. This violates the source model comment that baseline always reconciles, without requiring any runtime assumption.

When telemetry supplies no finite ambient reading, nativeAmbient falls back to the scenario ambient knob. Moving that knob changes climate0 and possibly other/total and baselineArrivalSoc, so the Actual drive baseline is not fixed for a fixed recording. For modeled0>observed, baseline total itself moves; otherwise the component split still changes.

Both picker labels and summary scope call pure formatDateShort without locale/timezone options. The pure helper uses host defaults; driveOptions memo depends only on drives/formatDistance. Saved effective timezone changes do not bind these labels, and selected locale is not supplied to either date call.

The sole ok=false result carries no ineligibility reason and merges missing drive, distance<10, observed<=0 and speed<=0. Page always describes this as missing energy. A measured zero energy, positive energy on a short recording, or known zero average speed are different facts from an absent energy measurement. Neutral zero fields are correctly suppressed by the summary, but source/domain reasons are not preserved.
